summary: The plan makes the in-app occasion screen's biggest tap target (the example video card) advance to the create step instead of dead-ending on video playback -- a fresh, never-attacked leak sitting inside the funnel's only review-producing engine, with the exchange, email gate, discount code, video delivery and printed-% rule all untouched. Its numbers reproduce exactly, it is honestly labelled unmeasurable-by-design rather than dressed as a proven win, and it preserves the video preview via an explicit play control, so I would defend it.

findings.issue: Small internal inconsistency in the review-click count between the plan's two evidence sources: the Supabase REST review-by-phase query (evidence item 9) reports 10 review clicks this window / 8 prior, while funnel-report (evidence item 1) reports 9 / 9. The plan quotes '10/10 this window, 7/8 prior' in choice_reasoning.
findings.evidence: Re-ran `node tools/funnel-report.mjs 14 --until=2026-08-15` -> review_clicked 9 (in_app receiver thankyou 6, in_app buyer thankyou 2, in_app receiver strong 1), 0 email_redirect. `--until=2026-08-01` -> review_clicked 9. The REST slice's 10/8 differs by a window-boundary row. Immaterial: the load-bearing claim (reviews arrive ~100% from the in-app thank-you screen, 0 from email_redirect in both windows) holds under either count, so the 'no review-reminder downstream cost' argument is unaffected.
findings.required_fix: None required. Optionally reconcile the two counts to one frozen query at re-measure so the ~2026-08-29 grade is internally consistent.

findings.issue: The assumed cause (occasion-screen affordance confusion) is a well-grounded bet, not a proven fact: the instruments are blind between role-select and Create-Viewed (no scroll-depth, video-play-duration, or button-focus events), and only ~4 mostly-idle recordings exist in-window, so 'tapped the video, watched, missed the forward button' cannot be distinguished from a genuine post-role interest ceiling. The one reconstructable engaged replay even advanced via 'Create from Scratch', not an example card.
findings.evidence: The plan itself discloses this in diagnosis.what_it_cannot_distinguish and cause_verification.against, and ships as measurable:false. This is acceptable rather than a blocker because (a) the change is low-risk and fully reversible, removes no exchange or reward, so the downside is bounded even if the cause is wrong; (b) the affordance flaw is a real UX defect regardless of attribution -- verified in code: handleExampleClick (index.html:2054) only calls toggleExamplePlay, so the dominant tap target genuinely dead-ends; (c) an instrumentation-only alternative would be a fifth straight invisible cycle, which the owner rule forbids, and the owner has already rejected a cycle for being too small. Shipping the visible fix is the better move here than shipping a measurement.
findings.required_fix: None required. Nice-to-have: add lightweight occasion-screen instrumentation (e.g. example-card tap vs play-control tap, forward-button focus) to ride along, so the ~2026-08-29 re-measure can tell affordance-fix from interest-ceiling instead of only re-reading the aggregate role->Create rate.
